convention: Sum of median component times from three sequential runs, including a cold physical-kernel construction with its channel caches reset. Both methods return informed values, one minimax and one maximin. The enumerator receives the same suffix sharing,4D prefixes and4x16 M contraction. Only the pruned method pays the independent family checker. Totals include kernel/preparation/encoding/compilation, certificate serialization and parsing, queries and both decision certificate construction/checking. Optional query-cache export is measured but excluded from the decision-only total.
